faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Can't find your answer here? Get in touch and we'll help.

questions.question: What metals do you buy?
questions.answer: We buy ferrous and non-ferrous metals, including copper, brass, aluminium, stainless steel, lead, electric motors, PVC wire, aluminium wheels, car parts, machinery and whole cars.

questions.question: Do you pick up scrap?
questions.answer: Yes. We collect scrap from homes, workshops and commercial sites. Book a pickup and we come to you.

questions.question: Can I hire a bin for my scrap?
questions.answer: Yes. We have bins in different sizes, though most jobs end up with a 1 m³ or a 2.4 m³ bin. We drop it off, you fill it, and we collect it when it is full.

questions.question: Do you buy cars that don’t run?
questions.answer: Yes. We buy cars, utes, vans and trucks in any condition, running or not, and tow them away for free.

questions.question: Do you take gas bottles?
questions.answer: No. We can't take gas bottles or LPG tanks, even empty ones, at the yard, in our bins or with a pickup. Your gas supplier or local council can tell you where to drop them off.

questions.question: How do I get a quote?
questions.answer: Contact us through the website, call 0470 131 025 or email info@metalwerx.com.au with what you have.
